===============


Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified "Great Place to Work™." We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Our team is growing and we're looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. ================



We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Graphic Designer (18 months contract) who will create compelling and innovative visual content that empowers our global network of customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!


**What you'll do:**
===================



As a Graphic Designer your key area of responsibility will be meticulously upholding Geotab's visual identity and sub\-identities, ensuring every piece of work strengthens our brand recognition and trust in the market, contributing to a wide array of projects, including digital, print, motion, environmental, experiential, and interactive applications, and delivering high\-quality, production\-ready outputs to ensure a seamless and professional execution of our brand across all platforms.You will need to work closely with senior creative leaders and an integrated team of stakeholders to ensure designs are aligned with creative strategy and business objectives.



To be successful in this role you will be a team player, who can operate effectively under pressure and to tight deadlines. In addition, the successful candidate will have good communication skills, and a strong portfolio demonstrating high\-quality design executions that reveal the problem\-solving process behind each creative solution and showcases technical versatility.


**How you'll make an impact:**
==============================


* Develop and create a range of visual assets, including layouts, illustrations, and digital graphics, based on the established art direction and concepts provided by creative leadership.
* Produce high\-quality, production\-ready files for various platforms including digital, print, and motion, ensuring technical specifications are met.
* Translate sketches, storyboards, and wireframes into polished, final designs for campaigns and marketing materials.
* Assist in the creation of presentations and mockups for stakeholder reviews and concept pitches.
* Collaborate during brainstorming sessions to help flesh out creative concepts and explore executional possibilities.
* Gather and prepare visual references, mood boards, and other assets to convey creative ideas to stakeholders under the direction of creative leadership.
* Work with content writers, marketing managers, and other team members to ensure design assets are correctly implemented and aligned with project goals.
* Implement design revisions and incorporate feedback from creative leadership and stakeholders efficiently and accurately through various stages of a project.
* Adapt designs across different formats and channels while maintaining the core visual identity.
* Strictly adhere to Geotab's brand guidelines in all design work, ensuring consistency in visual style, typography, and color palettes across every platform.
* Follow established creative project workflows and utilize designated collaboration tools to ensure project transparency and efficiency.
* Contribute to organizing and maintenance of creative assets and design files for future use in established asset management tools.

**What you'll bring to the role:**
==================================



* Degree specialization in Design or related field (BDes).
* Equivalent combination of education and/or work experience in related field may be substituted.
* 3\-5 years in interdisciplinary graphic design in an agency or in\-house creative team environment that might include creative support for campaigns, events (environmental/experiential), visual identity systems, and marketing collateral.
* Experience and willingness to work with AI tools.
* Experience with Google Suite, especially Google Slides and template building.
* Familiarity with project management/marketing tracking software (specifically Jira).
* Adobe Creative Suite and other industry standard design tools.
* Expert knowledge of design specs and media requirements for print and digital applications.
If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Job Description: **Join Our Creative Team!**

The Make Station is looking for energetic, creative, and reliable individuals who are passionate about inspiring children through art. We believe that **everyone is a maker**, and we're looking for instructors who can help foster confidence, creativity, and a love of making in every child who walks through our doors.

Previous experience working with children is required. Experience teaching visual arts is a strong asset, but we also welcome applicants with backgrounds in education, recreation, childcare, camps, or other creative fields.

**Position Details:** 

**Job Type:** Part\-time

**Hours:** Approximately **10–30 hours per week**, primarily weekday afternoons and evenings, with a **mandatory** either Saturday or Sunday availability.

Typical shifts include:

* Weekday classes: 1:00PM – 7:00PM
* Weekends : 10:00AM – 5:00PM

Preference will be given to candidates with greater availability, but we are happy to consider applicants available for select shifts.

**Location:**

The Make Station

1925 Gerrard St East Toronto

Toronto, Ontario

**Compensation:**

$17\.75\-$22 per hour, depending on experience. Bachelor of Education or Early Childhood Education certificates will be highly considered.

As an Art Instructor, you'll create a welcoming and encouraging environment where children feel excited to explore their creativity. You'll lead engaging art classes, camps, birthday parties, and workshops while helping each child build confidence through hands\-on making.

**Responsibilities include:**

* Planning and leading fun, age\-appropriate art projects for children ages 5–16\.
* Teaching a variety of mediums including drawing, painting, sculpture, mixed media, clay, digital art, photography, and more (**training provided** where needed).
* Preparing materials and maintaining a clean, organized studio.
* Encouraging creativity while adapting projects to different ages and skill levels.
* Building positive relationships with children through patience, kindness, and enthusiasm.
* Greeting families and communicating professionally with parents.
* Assisting with birthday parties, PA Day camps, March Break camps, Summer Camps, and special studio events.
* Helping maintain a safe, welcoming, and inspiring studio environment.
* Other duties as required.

**We're looking for someone who is:**

* Passionate about working with children.
* Creative, energetic, and enthusiastic.
* Organized, dependable, and punctual.
* Comfortable leading groups independently.
* Patient, encouraging, and able to adapt to different learning styles.
* A positive team player who enjoys collaborating with others.
* Excited to learn new art techniques and teach them confidently.

**Qualifications:** 

* Previous experience working with children (**required**).
* Experience teaching art, leading camps, recreational programming, or educational activities is an asset.
* Background in Fine Arts, Art Education, Recreation, or a related field is considered an asset but is not required.
* **Bachelor of Education or Early Childhood Education is a major asset.**
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* **Ability to lift and carry art supplies and equipment (up to 20 kg).**
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced creative environment.

**Successful candidates will be required to obtain or provide:**

* Valid Standard First Aid \& CPR\-C (or willingness to obtain before starting).
* Clear Vulnerable Sector Check.
* Signed disclosure statement regarding any prior convictions.

**Our hiring process includes:**

* Resume review.
* Short zoom interview.
* In\-person interview.
* Trial shift teaching alongside our team.
* Two to three professional references, preferably from supervisors who can speak to your experience working with children.

At The Make Station, we're more than an art studio—we're a creative community. We believe every child deserves a space where they feel inspired, supported, and celebrated.

As part of our team you'll enjoy:

* A fun, supportive, and collaborative workplace.
* Opportunities to teach a wide variety of creative programs.
* Training in our unique teaching approach and projects.
* Creative freedom and opportunities to contribute new ideas.
* The chance to make a meaningful impact on young artists every day.

If you'd like to join our team for the **2026–2027 school year**, we'd love to hear from you!

Please send us (info@themakestation.ca):

* Your resume
* A short paragraph introducing yourself and telling us why you'd be a great fit for The Make Station.
* Any relevant experience working with children and/or teaching art.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including members of equity\-deserving communities.

Pay: $17\.75\-$22\.00 per hour

Flexible language requirement:

* French not required

Education:

* Bachelor's Degree (preferred)

Experience:

* Childcare: 1 year (required)

Work Location: In person

Career Opportunities (sapsf.com)
  
  

General Purpose
  
  

The Ontario Veterinary College (OVC) is a world leader in advancing veterinary science, education, and research with a mission to improve the health and lives of animals, people, and our planet. The Institute of Comparative Cancer Investigation (ICCI) is a collaborative research initiative within OVC dedicated to advancing comparative oncology through innovative research, partnerships, and knowledge translation.
  
  

Reporting to ICCI leadership, the Research Assistant/Technician III (Biobank Coordinator) plays a critical role in supporting the ongoing development and operations of the OVC Biobank. This position is responsible for the coordination and stewardship of biological sample collections and associated data, enabling high\-quality research that supports both internal and external investigators.
  
  

Working in a highly collaborative research environment, the Coordinator will contribute to biobank operations, data integrity, and research access processes, while also supporting ICCI initiatives including research coordination, communications, and event planning. The role requires a high degree of independence, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage complex data and processes with accuracy and discretion.
  
  

Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

Coordinate and support the collection, processing, storage, and tracking of biological samples and associated data in alignment with established protocols and procedures
  
Maintain and enhance the biobank database, including data entry, validation, quality control, and addressing historical data gaps to ensure completeness and accuracy
  
Respond to researcher inquiries and coordinate access to samples, including assessing availability, preparing documentation, ensuring appropriate data handling and de\-identification, and facilitating shipment or transfer
  
Support the development, documentation, and ongoing review of standard operating procedures and ensure adherence to applicable research protocols and certification requirements
  
Participate in external biobanking initiatives and networks, including contributing to reporting, data submissions, and working groups
  
Coordinate ICCI activities and initiatives, including the planning and delivery of the annual Cancer Research Symposium and related communications
  
Provide administrative and operational support to ICCI programs, including communications, listserv updates, meeting coordination, and outreach activities
  
Support inventory and equipment tracking processes, including monitoring usage, coordinating maintenance, and assisting with procurement and vendor interactions
  
Generates progress reports for research team, writes and/or acts as resource for the development of laboratory protocols
  
Enforces laboratory safety rules and procedures
  
Serves as a source of information or reference on standard research techniques, and trains others in technical procedures or operations, including use of precision laboratory equipment and instruments and provide recommendations on appropriate use, including guidance to students on use of equipment or standard research techniques for their research projects.
  
Sets up, tests, calibrates, operates and maintains complex laboratory and other equipment; some troubleshooting to resolve equipment malfunctions before arranging for repairs; analyzes test results to measure the performance of developed systems and makes adjustments to experimental prototypes/systems as required
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Undergraduate degree in a relevant field with experience in a research, laboratory, healthcare, or academic environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  
Experience working with databases and managing data quality, with demonstrated attention to detail and accuracy
  
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
  
Excellent interpersonal, communication (verbal and written), and relationship\-building skills
  
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research environment
  
Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information
  
Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures, or research protocols
  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ability to learn and use specialized software systems
  
Experience in a biobanking, clinical research, or academic setting is considered an asset

General Purpose
  
  

The Ontario Veterinary College (OVC) is a world leader in advancing veterinary science, education, and research with a mission to improve the health and lives of animals, people, and our planet. The Institute of Comparative Cancer Investigation (ICCI) is a collaborative research initiative within OVC dedicated to advancing comparative oncology through innovative research, partnerships, and knowledge translation.
  
  

Reporting to ICCI leadership, the Research Assistant/Technician III (Biobank Coordinator) plays a critical role in supporting the ongoing development and operations of the OVC Biobank. This position is responsible for the coordination and stewardship of biological sample collections and associated data, enabling high\-quality research that supports both internal and external investigators.
  
  

Working in a highly collaborative research environment, the Coordinator will contribute to biobank operations, data integrity, and research access processes, while also supporting ICCI initiatives including research coordination, communications, and event planning. The role requires a high degree of independence, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage complex data and processes with accuracy and discretion.
  
  

Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

Coordinate and support the collection, processing, storage, and tracking of biological samples and associated data in alignment with established protocols and procedures
  
Maintain and enhance the biobank database, including data entry, validation, quality control, and addressing historical data gaps to ensure completeness and accuracy
  
Respond to researcher inquiries and coordinate access to samples, including assessing availability, preparing documentation, ensuring appropriate data handling and de\-identification, and facilitating shipment or transfer
  
Support the development, documentation, and ongoing review of standard operating procedures and ensure adherence to applicable research protocols and certification requirements
  
Participate in external biobanking initiatives and networks, including contributing to reporting, data submissions, and working groups
  
Coordinate ICCI activities and initiatives, including the planning and delivery of the annual Cancer Research Symposium and related communications
  
Provide administrative and operational support to ICCI programs, including communications, listserv updates, meeting coordination, and outreach activities
  
Support inventory and equipment tracking processes, including monitoring usage, coordinating maintenance, and assisting with procurement and vendor interactions
  
Generates progress reports for research team, writes and/or acts as resource for the development of laboratory protocols
  
Enforces laboratory safety rules and procedures
  
Serves as a source of information or reference on standard research techniques, and trains others in technical procedures or operations, including use of precision laboratory equipment and instruments and provide recommendations on appropriate use, including guidance to students on use of equipment or standard research techniques for their research projects.
  
Sets up, tests, calibrates, operates and maintains complex laboratory and other equipment; some troubleshooting to resolve equipment malfunctions before arranging for repairs; analyzes test results to measure the performance of developed systems and makes adjustments to experimental prototypes/systems as required
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Undergraduate degree in a relevant field with experience in a research, laboratory, healthcare, or academic environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  
Experience working with databases and managing data quality, with demonstrated attention to detail and accuracy
  
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
  
Excellent interpersonal, communication (verbal and written), and relationship\-building skills
  
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research environment
  
Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information
  
Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures, or research protocols
  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ability to learn and use specialized software systems
  
Experience in a biobanking, clinical research, or academic setting is considered an asset

**About us:**  

The Faculty of Arts \& Science is the heart of Canada’s leading university and one of the most comprehensive and diverse academic divisions in the world. Working under the supervision of the Research Awards \& Honours Strategy Officer and reporting to the Director of Research Services, the Research Awards \& Honours Coordinator will play a critical role in supporting the development of competitive research awards, honours, and prize nominations for Arts \& Science (A\&S) faculty members. **Your responsibilities will include:**  

Developing and implementing plans that support the attainment of research awards and honours
  
Assessing and recommending academics for research related awards and prizes
  
Leading seminars and/or workshops
  
Drafting and editing funding applications
  
Verifying research funding proposals are complete, accurate and adhereto sponsor guidelines
  
Applying and interpreting policies and procedures in decision\-making independently
  
Promoting research initiatives to increase program visibility and reputation
  
Fostering and maintaining relationships with existing and potential sponsors
  
  

**Essential Qualifications:**  

Bachelor's Degree or acceptable combination of equivalent experience.
  
Minimum five years working in an academic research administration, government/funding agency environment or related work experience related to the responsibilities of the position.
  
Demonstrated experience supporting faculty/researchers in the preparation, creating and editing of research award submission materials.
  
Demonstrated experience in coordinating the implementation of research administration projects and programs and ability to foster positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  
Experience with information management and data analysis.
  
Excellent interpersonal and problem\-solving skills and a commitment to delivering the highest level of customer service.
  
Strong computer skills with experience in MS Office such as Word, PowerPoint, One Drive, SharePoint, Excel, various media and digital platforms and other software packages.
  
Excellent written and oral communication, presentation, organizational and time management skills.
  
Strong commitment to accuracy and attention to detail.
  
Applicants are also expected to show evidence of a commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion, and the promotion of a respectful and collegial learning and working environment.

Experience workingin a similar research administration office setting is desirable.

* Perform comprehensive financial statement analysis and create and maintain financial models

Liaise with sales, trading and other areas of the firm within regulatory guidelines  
*

* A university degree in business or a relevant discipline

* Experience using Bloomberg and FactSet

* Excellent command of Microsoft Suite, with an emphasis on Excel
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Good business judgment and decision\-making skills
* Ability to perform under pressure and meet tight deadlines
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of work

A high level of energy and a keen desire to learn  
*

This position is an onsite role, with the expectation that you will work 5 days a week in the office. Please note that this is subject to change based on the needs of the business.

The Make Station

Toronto, Ontario

* Other duties as required.

* Creative, energetic, and enthusiastic.
* Organized, dependable, and punctual.

* A positive team player who enjoys collaborating with others.
* Excited to learn new art techniques and teach them confidently.

* Experience teaching art, leading camps, recreational programming, or educational activities is an asset.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* **Ability to lift and carry art supplies and equipment (up to 20 kg).**
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced creative environment.

* Valid Standard First Aid \& CPR\-C (or willingness to obtain before starting).
* Clear Vulnerable Sector Check.
* Signed disclosure statement regarding any prior convictions.

* Short zoom interview.
* In\-person interview.
* Trial shift teaching alongside our team.
* Two to three professional references, preferably from supervisors who can speak to your experience working with children.

* A fun, supportive, and collaborative workplace.
* Opportunities to teach a wide variety of creative programs.
* Training in our unique teaching approach and projects.
* Creative freedom and opportunities to contribute new ideas.
* The chance to make a meaningful impact on young artists every day.

* Your resume
* A short paragraph introducing yourself and telling us why you'd be a great fit for The Make Station.
* Any relevant experience working with children and/or teaching art.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including members of equity\-deserving communities.

Support inventory and equipment tracking processes, including monitoring usage, coordinating maintenance, and assisting with procurement and vendor interactions
  
Generates progress reports for research team, writes and/or acts as resource for the development of laboratory protocols
  
Enforces laboratory safety rules and procedures

Sets up, tests, calibrates, operates and maintains complex laboratory and other equipment; some troubleshooting to resolve equipment malfunctions before arranging for repairs; analyzes test results to measure the performance of developed systems and makes adjustments to experimental prototypes/systems as required

Excellent interpersonal, communication (verbal and written), and relationship\-building skills
  
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research environment
  
Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information
  
Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures, or research protocols
  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ability to learn and use specialized software systems

The Ontario Veterinary College (OVC) is a world leader in advancing veterinary science, education, and research with a mission to improve the health and lives of animals, people, and our planet. The Institute of Comparative Cancer Investigation (ICCI) is a collaborative research initiative within OVC dedicated to advancing comparative oncology through innovative research, partnerships, and knowledge translation.
  
  

Reporting to ICCI leadership, the Research Assistant/Technician III (Biobank Coordinator) plays a critical role in supporting the ongoing development and operations of the OVC Biobank. This position is responsible for the coordination and stewardship of biological sample collections and associated data, enabling high\-quality research that supports both internal and external investigators.
  
  

Working in a highly collaborative research environment, the Coordinator will contribute to biobank operations, data integrity, and research access processes, while also supporting ICCI initiatives including research coordination, communications, and event planning. The role requires a high degree of independence, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage complex data and processes with accuracy and discretion.
  
  

Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

Coordinate and support the collection, processing, storage, and tracking of biological samples and associated data in alignment with established protocols and procedures
  
Maintain and enhance the biobank database, including data entry, validation, quality control, and addressing historical data gaps to ensure completeness and accuracy
  
Respond to researcher inquiries and coordinate access to samples, including assessing availability, preparing documentation, ensuring appropriate data handling and de\-identification, and facilitating shipment or transfer
  
Support the development, documentation, and ongoing review of standard operating procedures and ensure adherence to applicable research protocols and certification requirements
  
Participate in external biobanking initiatives and networks, including contributing to reporting, data submissions, and working groups
  
Coordinate ICCI activities and initiatives, including the planning and delivery of the annual Cancer Research Symposium and related communications
  
Provide administrative and operational support to ICCI programs, including communications, listserv updates, meeting coordination, and outreach activities
  
Support inventory and equipment tracking processes, including monitoring usage, coordinating maintenance, and assisting with procurement and vendor interactions
  
Generates progress reports for research team, writes and/or acts as resource for the development of laboratory protocols
  
Enforces laboratory safety rules and procedures
  
Serves as a source of information or reference on standard research techniques, and trains others in technical procedures or operations, including use of precision laboratory equipment and instruments and provide recommendations on appropriate use, including guidance to students on use of equipment or standard research techniques for their research projects.
  
Sets up, tests, calibrates, operates and maintains complex laboratory and other equipment; some troubleshooting to resolve equipment malfunctions before arranging for repairs; analyzes test results to measure the performance of developed systems and makes adjustments to experimental prototypes/systems as required
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Undergraduate degree in a relevant field with experience in a research, laboratory, healthcare, or academic environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  
Experience working with databases and managing data quality, with demonstrated attention to detail and accuracy
  
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
  
Excellent interpersonal, communication (verbal and written), and relationship\-building skills
  
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research environment
  
Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information
  
Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures, or research protocols
  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ability to learn and use specialized software systems
  
Experience in a biobanking, clinical research, or academic setting is considered an asset

* Perform comprehensive financial statement analysis and create and maintain financial models

* Collect, consolidate and interpret company and industry data

Liaise with sales, trading and other areas of the firm within regulatory guidelines

* A university degree in business or a relevant discipline
* MBA, Master of Finance degree, Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation or enrolment in/completion of the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) program is preferred
* Work experience in a financial, analytical, corporate development or M\&A capacity would be an asset

* Experience in analyzing financial statements and valuing companies
* Experience using Bloomberg and FactSet

* Excellent command of Microsoft Suite, with an emphasis on Excel
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Good business judgment and decision\-making skills
* Ability to perform under pressure and meet tight deadlines
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of work

A high level of energy and a keen desire to learn  
*

This position is an onsite role, with the expectation that you will work 5 days a week in the office. Please note that this is subject to change based on the needs of the business.

Reporting to ICCI leadership, the Research Assistant/Technician III (Biobank Coordinator) plays a critical role in supporting the ongoing development and operations of the OVC Biobank. This position is responsible for the coordination and stewardship of biological sample collections and associated data, enabling high\-quality research that supports both internal and external investigators.
  
  

Working in a highly collaborative research environment, the Coordinator will contribute to biobank operations, data integrity, and research access processes, while also supporting ICCI initiatives including research coordination, communications, and event planning. Maintain and enhance the biobank database, including data entry, validation, quality control, and addressing historical data gaps to ensure completeness and accuracy
  
Respond to researcher inquiries and coordinate access to samples, including assessing availability, preparing documentation, ensuring appropriate data handling and de\-identification, and facilitating shipment or transfer
  
Support the development, documentation, and ongoing review of standard operating procedures and ensure adherence to applicable research protocols and certification requirements
  
Participate in external biobanking initiatives and networks, including contributing to reporting, data submissions, and working groups
  
Coordinate ICCI activities and initiatives, including the planning and delivery of the annual Cancer Research Symposium and related communications
  
Provide administrative and operational support to ICCI programs, including communications, listserv updates, meeting coordination, and outreach activities
  
Support inventory and equipment tracking processes, including monitoring usage, coordinating maintenance, and assisting with procurement and vendor interactions
  
Generates progress reports for research team, writes and/or acts as resource for the development of laboratory protocols
  
Enforces laboratory safety rules and procedures
  
Serves as a source of information or reference on standard research techniques, and trains others in technical procedures or operations, including use of precision laboratory equipment and instruments and provide recommendations on appropriate use, including guidance to students on use of equipment or standard research techniques for their research projects.
  
Sets up, tests, calibrates, operates and maintains complex laboratory and other equipment; some troubleshooting to resolve equipment malfunctions before arranging for repairs; analyzes test results to measure the performance of developed systems and makes adjustments to experimental prototypes/systems as required
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Undergraduate degree in a relevant field with experience in a research, laboratory, healthcare, or academic environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  
Experience working with databases and managing data quality, with demonstrated attention to detail and accuracy
  
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
  
Excellent interpersonal, communication (verbal and written), and relationship\-building skills
  
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research environment
  
Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information
  
Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures, or research protocols
  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ability to learn and use specialized software systems
  
Experience in a biobanking, clinical research, or academic setting is considered an asset
